item.title: About Me
item.description: Hey folks, thanks for visiting my page! I’m a PhD candidate in the School of Physics and Astronomy at Monash University 🐨. I love using some of the most energetic and voilent bangs in the Universe to learn more about extreme events that caused them. I do this by analysing gravitational waves detected by the the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory ([LIGO]{:target="_blank"}). So far, we’ve detected gravitational waves from the collisions of black holes and neutron stars (both with themselves and with each other). A binary black hole merger can emit energy equivalent to the mass of several Suns in a fraction of a second!
